view.stem:
在各原式有意义的实数变量范围内，把下列三式写成单个分式。哪份完整记录正确？
a) $\left(\frac{x}{2y}\right)^3$；
b) $\left(\frac{3a}{c}\right)^4$；
c) $\left(\frac{-a}{3b}\right)^3$。

intent.task: Expand three basic fraction powers with coefficient and odd/even sign scope.
intent.source_solution: a x^3/(8y^3),y!=0; b81a^4/c^4,c!=0; c-a^3/(27b^3),b!=0; d-m^6/(1000q^3),q!=0; e10000a^16/(81x^16),x!=0; f x^20/y^8,y!=0; g64/(p^24q^18),p,q!=0; h-a^24/(125c^18) for b!=0,c!=0, with a unrestricted; i100000x^25/y^50,y!=0. In h the printed b^0 has an unresolved zero-base case at b=0 because the selected definition does not state a convention for0^0. If undefined, b=0 is excluded; if separately defined as1, it is permitted. Do not silently turn the conditional h calculation into a certified full original-domain statement.
intent.unit_reason: One three-result record compares coefficient exponentiation, variable powers and the explicit odd negative sign while keeping each original fraction domain as an input condition.
limitations: Recognizing the complete fraction record does not establish independently expanding and writing every power. Original domains are retained, not extended after rewriting.

rationales.derivation: Power numeric coefficients and signs correctly, but regard every variable as a first power and add the outer exponent:1+3=4,1+4=5,1+3=4 in both numerator and denominator.
rationales.misconception: Add inner and outer variable exponents instead of multiplying them.

rationales.derivation: Raise variable powers correctly but leave numeric coefficients unchanged: denominator2 instead of8, numerator3 instead of81, denominator3 instead of27.
rationales.misconception: Apply the power only to variables, not numeric coefficients.

rationales.derivation: Power both numerator and denominator.2^3=8,3^4=81,3^3=27; the negative coefficient stays negative under the odd cube. Domains remain y,c,b nonzero in the respective rows.

After correctly raising the fractions, invert each whole result as though a power operation required a reciprocal. These values are reciprocals of the actual ones and are also undefined at some permitted numerator-zero inputs.
rationales.misconception: Take an unnecessary reciprocal after raising a fraction to a power.

Raise variable factors but leave each signed numeric coefficient unchanged: -1/10,10/3,-1 are retained instead of -1/1000,10000/81,+1.

In i,2/0.2=10 and10^5=100000; exponents multiply to25 and50. This proves only the visible qualified h domain, not the unresolved original b=0 case.

view.stem:
化简：
a）$\left(\frac{a^3}{b^2}\right)^3\cdot\left(\frac{b^4}{a^2}\right)^4$；
b）$\left(-\frac{2x^4}{y^5}\right)^4\cdot\left(\frac{y^7}{4x^6}\right)^3$；
c）$\left(-\frac{3x^7}{a^{12}}\right):\left(-\frac{9x^5}{a^8}\right)^3$；
d）$\left(\frac{8a^3}{9b^2}\right)^3\cdot\left(-\frac{27b^3}{16a^4}\right)^2$．

intent.task: Reduce all four nested-power products and the signed quotient on their original domains.
intent.source_solution: a a*b^10, a,b!=0; b y/(4x^2),x,y!=0; c a^12/(243x^8),a,x!=0; d2a,a,b!=0. Compute nested powers before products/quotients; c divides by(-9x^5/a^8)^3=-729x^15/a^24, so both negatives cancel. d coefficient512/729 times729/256 is2. Preserve original zeros even in the reduced polynomial outputs.
intent.unit_reason: One four-result record compares product cancellation with a powered divisor, coefficient exponentiation and sign scope.
limitations: Recognizing the complete fraction record does not establish independently expanding and writing every power. Original domains are retained, not extended after rewriting.

rationales.derivation: Raise variable factors correctly but leave signed numeric coefficients unchanged. a scalar1 stays1;b scalar(-2)*(1/4)=-1/2;c scalar(-3)/(-9)=1/3;d scalar(8/9)*(-27/16)=-3/2. The last three differ from the actual powered coefficients.
rationales.misconception: Exclude all signed numeric coefficients from the nested powers.

rationales.derivation: Expand powers then combine: a a^(9-8)b^(16-6);b(16/64)x^(16-18)y^(21-20);c(-3)/(-729) times a^(24-12)x^(7-15);d(512/729)*(729/256)*a^(9-8)b^(6-6). Retain original nonzero denominator/divisor variables.
After obtaining the correct reduced fractions, invert every entire result, incorrectly carrying over a reciprocal operation to all products and the finished quotient.
rationales.misconception: Take the reciprocal of the final simplification even when no reciprocal is required.

rationales.derivation: Expand powers and numeric coefficients correctly, including reciprocal division in c. Then move all denominator variable factors above the fraction bar:9+8=17,6+16=22;16+18=34,20+21=41;24+12=36,7+15=22;9+8=17,6+6=12.
rationales.misconception: Add denominator powers to numerator powers after otherwise correct expansion.

intent.task: Evaluate both exact power quotients by common-prime-base conversion.
intent.source_solution: a2^(6-10)*3^(10-10)=1/16. b2^(6+18-25)*3^(18-18)=1/2. Prime-base conversion and exact exponent differences suffice without approximate decimal expansion.
intent.unit_reason: The paired result tests the two different cancellations without giving either result in another unit.

rationales.derivation: Prime-base conversion is correct but the quotient exponent differences are reversed. Actual exponents-4,-1 are treated as+4,+1, giving16 and2.
rationales.misconception: Subtract numerator exponents from denominator exponents and keep the reciprocal result.

rationales.derivation: Use (u^r)^s=u^(r+s) only at nested powers produced by prime-base conversion.4^3=(2^2)^3 becomes2^5, giving2^(5-10)=1/32.9^9=(3^2)^9 becomes3^11, giving2^-1*3^(18-11)=2187/2.

intent.task: Count every rectangle, including unions of adjacent cells, from the actual complete source figure.
intent.source_solution: Actual full figure108 is one row divided into four adjacent cells, with five full vertical boundaries and two full horizontal boundaries. Choose any two of the five vertical boundaries: C(5,2)*C(2,2)=10 rectangles. Equivalent width classification:4 one-cell,3 two-cell,2 three-cell,1 four-cell rectangle. Counts include combined cells, not only the four smallest squares.

limitations: Recognition does not establish independently enumerating or drawing every counted rectangle.

Five full-height vertical lines and two horizontal lines, one row and four columns; the far-right outer edge and entire bottom boundary are not cropped. No labels or hidden second row.
